scenarios.title: V kaviarni
scenarios.situation: Ste v kaviarni v Bratislave a chcete si objednať kávu, koláč a zaplatiť účet.
scenarios.situationEn: You are at a café in Bratislava and want to order a coffee, a cake, and pay the bill.
scenarios.targetCompetency: I can order drinks and snacks in a Slovak café and pay

turns.interlocutorTranslation: Good day! What will you have?
turns.learnerCue: Pozdravte a objednajte si kávu (alebo čaj) a jablkový koláč.
turns.learnerCueEn: Greet and order a coffee (or tea) and an apple cake.
vocabularyHints: dám si čiernu kávu — I'll have a black coffee
kávu s mliekom — coffee with milk

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Výborne, káva a koláč. Dáte si ešte niečo na pitie alebo minerálku?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: Great, coffee and cake. Would you like anything else to drink or mineral water?
turns.learnerCue: Odpovedzte, že minerálku bez bubliniek (tichú vodu) alebo nie, ďakujem.
turns.learnerCueEn: Reply asking for still water or say no, thank you.
vocabularyHints: to je všetko — that is all

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Páči sa, tu je vaša káva a koláč. Chutí vám?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: Here you go, here is your coffee and cake. Is everything tasting good?
turns.learnerCue: Poďakujte, pochváľte koláč a požiadajte o účet.
turns.learnerCueEn: Thank the waiter, praise the cake, and ask for the bill.
vocabularyHints: ďakujem, je to výborné — thank you, it is excellent
zaplatím, prosím — I will pay, please
môžem platiť kartou? — can I pay by card?

scenarios.title: Na stanici
scenarios.situation: Hľadáte vlak na hlavnej stanici v Bratislave a pýtate sa na odchod a nástupište.
scenarios.situationEn: You are at the main station in Bratislava asking for train departure and platform details.
scenarios.targetCompetency: I can ask for simple travel directions and train times in Slovak

turns.interlocutorTranslation: Good day, may I help you?
turns.learnerCue: Pozdravte, ospravedlňte sa a spýtajte sa, kedy odchádza vlak do Košíc.
turns.learnerCueEn: Greet, excuse yourself, and ask when the train to Košice leaves.
vocabularyHints: prepáčte, kedy odchádza vlak? — excuse me, when does the train leave?
vlak do Košíc — train to Košice

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Rýchlik do Košíc odchádza o desiatej hodine z tretieho nástupišťa.
turns.interlocutorTranslation: The express train to Košice departs at ten o'clock from platform 3.
turns.learnerCueEn: Say thank you and wish them a nice day.
vocabularyHints: veľmi pekne ďakujem — thank you very much
pekný deň — have a nice day
